notes_for_editor: Possible mix-up to check: the Middle Sister lookout also lost a tower in 1953 (firelookout.com/id/middlesister.html; Spokane Historical item 588 says the Middle Sisters tower was a cupola built in 1923, replaced in 1951, and burned in 1953). The firelookout.com Middle Sister page gives the same 1923, 1951 and 1953 sequence; the Spokane item was not checked in this pass. The Sisters Basin 1932 date and 1953 'Gone' come only from the two Sisters Basin pages, and neither explains the loss. Worth checking against St. Joe National Forest records before publication. The 1953 event is recorded as 'other' with the note 'Listed as gone; the cause is not stated', because the source wording is only 'Gone'. Idaho Fire Lookouts says no staffing history is documented; firelookout.com does not mention staffing, so staffing is omitted. The Donally history (npshistory) does not name this lookout, so it does not explain the 1932 date. No photos were found and no FFLOS or NHLR register page for this site was in the cache.
